
## Findings

- [Findings](https://marketingmedido.com/findings/): what Medido finds when it reads real websites, and what you can check yourself. English only.
- [Google Ads Audit: What I Found on 200 Real Sites](https://marketingmedido.com/findings/google-ads-audit-what-i-found/): What a Google Ads audit misses: what I found when I read the tracking on 200 real websites, what it means for your ads, and five checks you can do today.
- [GA4 Audit: What I Found on 200 Real Websites](https://marketingmedido.com/findings/ga4-audit-what-i-found/): A GA4 audit from real data: what I saw when I read Google Analytics 4 on 200 websites, which mistakes repeat, and six checks you can do yourself.
- [Is Hiring a Marketing Agency Worth It? How to Check](https://marketingmedido.com/findings/is-a-marketing-agency-worth-it/): Is hiring a marketing agency worth it? What I saw on 200 real websites, five signs that nobody is checking the numbers, and five questions to ask.
- [Google Ads Audit Template: What a Useful One Includes](https://marketingmedido.com/findings/google-ads-audit-template/): A Google Ads audit template you can copy: the fields to fill, where to find each one in your account, and what to do when a number does not add up.
